description.value: Planet Bee is a working honey farm and meadery on the outskirts of Vernon, BC, where visitors can observe on-site beehives, stroll bee-friendly gardens, and sample honey and mead at the daily tasting bar — all free of charge. The farm produces Western Canada's largest curated selection of raw honey, bottled by hand on-site in the Okanagan Valley. Educational group presentations are offered seasonally, making it a genuinely engaging stop for curious travellers.
